Per Court :-

The petitioners' claim for compensation in terms of Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act has been turned out by the order dated 21.01.2020.
The petitioners may challenge the said order.
We dispose of these three contempt petitions in view of the said order.
2. In view of the same, the contempt petitions are disposed of with liberty to challenge the said order .

( SANJAY A. DESHMUKH ) ( R. G. AVACHAT )
 JUDGE JUDGE P.S.B.
